propOwnership.cancellation: Cancel service player and hide/reclaim pooled props on epoch, hidden, mode/import, loss or dispose; no delayed callbacks. Ordinary paint/settings do not reset playback.
propOwnership.bound: Five pooled nodes: two generic bag nodes, box, note and cloth. At most one carried bag plus one staff task prop. Same actual held bag node transfers to customer; reserve becomes the staff bag.

portable: Named node contract, mesh masters and motion data are reusable. Babylon adapter and future native engine binding still require platform integration and actual visual checks.

staffClearanceArc.method: Elbow-first tuck, shoulder lift, then unfold above counter. Reverse ordering on recovery. Left supporting hand holds its raised pose during sale release.
staffClearanceArc.geometryVerification: Use actual generated hand/forearm vertices transformed through RH node hierarchy against counter bounds; non-visual geometry evidence, not GPU visual acceptance.

crossClipTransition.duration: maximum of incoming and outgoing STAFF_CLIPS.blend, clamped to .15–.25 seconds
crossClipTransition.pose: Snapshot current rendered rest-relative pose; smooth head/body/yaw and expression weights. For active work arms tuck elbows, move shoulders, unfold. Authored neutral entries retain their existing safe envelope.
crossClipTransition.prop: One outgoing prop fades during first transition quarter while still safely held; incoming prop withheld until end. No duplicate held objects. Renderer preserves world pose on owner changes and applies propOpacity.
crossClipTransition.idle: Own elapsed task clock; first tidy at6seconds and alternate note/tidy on16second start cadence. External service/greet discards interrupted task, then waits16seconds before fresh work. No global modulo midpoint resume.
crossClipTransition.cancellation: cancel/reset immediately clear prop/transition on explicit hide/skip/reduced-motion; ordinary repaint preserves player state.
